name: Munich 72 Banknote Security
description: Munich 1972 Swiss modernist x banknote security-print cover. Cream central panel framed by orange/cyan/lime/gray bordered color blocks; nested-arc rainbow semicircular line-art motif near the top; dense moire/lattice interlaced wave band in the lower half. Extracted from style-01 reference set. Portrait 1.6:1 / 2:3.

layout.composition: Cream/off-white central panel occupying most of the canvas, framed by segmented bordered color blocks (orange, cyan, lime, gray). Nested-arc rainbow semicircular line-art motif just below the top tool line. Moire/lattice interlaced wave band spanning the lower half above the author block.
layout.margins: 10% safe zone; tool line at top center; author + edition at bottom center over the moire band

typography.hierarchy: Title largest navy display 'Open Design'; subtitle centered two lines; author + edition smaller bottom

palette.contrast: navy/ink display type on cream; color blocks frame the cream panel

prompt.art: Munich 1972 Swiss modernist book cover, PORTRAIT. A large cream/off-white central panel framed by segmented bordered color blocks in signal orange, cyan, lime green, and pale gray. Near the top of the cream panel, a detailed black-and-gray line-art semiconircular nested-arc / rainbow motif built from dense crosshatched curves. The lower half of the cream panel carries a large intricate field of thin gray curving lines forming repeated overlapping wave, diamond, eye, and lattice shapes in horizontal bands (woven / moire). NO watermark, NO logo, NO signature. Palette: cream, orange, cyan, lime, gray, indigo, ink, yellow, lavender. Genre: {genre}.
prompt.negative: no watermark, no logo, no signature, no 'Grok', no text attribution, no stadium, no ticket, no people, no photos, no 3D, no gradients, no drop shadows, no mint/dark-green dominance, no Olympic rings, no '1972'
prompt.roleRefs: Use the reference images as the banknote texture + Munich palette + composition authority. Copy the guilloche oval lattice and engraved line-density textures, the bordered color-block frame, and the cream central panel. Do not copy subjects or add watermarks.
